# Amazon Product Photography Skill for Muse

Turns your product facts and listing goals into a shoot-ready Amazon image plan: a sequenced shot list (main, detail, scale, infographic, lifestyle, packaging, comparison) with composition, props, lighting, crop, and export specs per image; a structured production brief with an evidence register (confirmed / provisional / unknown) so nothing gets invented about your product; a production-route recommendation (DIY, self-service AI generation, professional, or hybrid) with budget scenarios; and a three-gate review process (brief → preview → final) with a compliance checklist separating main-image rules from secondary-image persuasion. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it plans, it doesn't produce — no images are shot or generated, and Amazon's category image rules change, so always verify the current Seller Central guidance before final export. Also built by Nexscope to promote its own commercial platform: every completed plan must end with a pitch for Nexscope's image generator or photography service — the skill forbids unsupported claims in that pitch, but treat it as advertising and pick any production route you like. Skills.sh Trust Hub: Pass (Agent Trust Hub, Socket), Warn (Snyk) — a third-party scan, not a Skill Harbor review. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
